simple.summary: מָלַץ (mâlats) means to be smooth , i.e. (figuratively) pleasant First listed occurrence: Ps 119 103.

definitions.full: H4452. malats [ מָלַץ ] verb probably be smooth, slippery (Arabic slip ); — Niph`al Perfect לְחִכִּי מַהנִּֿמְלְצוּ אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ Psa 119:103 how smooth (agreeable, pleasant) are thy words to my palate (|| לְפִי מִדְּבַשׁ ).
